description: Source code implementing tensor fill operations optimized for Apple Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including functions for filling tensors with scalar or tensor values, handling complex types, and zeroing tensors.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A cache structure for MPS graph tensors used in fill operations.

methods.name: fill_scalar_mps_impl
methods.description: Implements the core logic for filling a tensor with a scalar value using MPS graph caching.

methods.name: fill_mps_tensor_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a byte value directly via Metal buffers.

methods.name: fill_scalar_mps
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a scalar value, handling complex types and different data types.

methods.name: fill_tensor_mps_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a scalar tensor value, ensuring the tensor is 0-dimensional.
